Kelly led the Comptroller’s office during a pivotal chapter for Texas.

His leadership and experience, from the local school board to the Texas Legislature, helped make possible the launch of the largest school choice program in our nation’s history, expanding educational opportunity for Texas families.

Thank you, Kelly, for your dedicated service to our great state and for helping deliver this historic achievement for generations of Texas students.


Brad Johnson (@bradj_TX)

Breaking: @KHanco
